verified_lap.path: build fixed the real defect -> verify independently confirmed (re-ran grep probe itself, exit 0, old port line gone) -> route-verified live / route-failed pruned -> land_gate held for human -> released 'land' -> land recorded -> closeout outcome=landed, runner_exit done.

failed_lap.path: build applied a DELIBERATELY WRONG fix (comment-only, port still invalid) with honest self-verdict not-fixed -> verifier's own probe FAILED it (the probe outranks any claim - verification asymmetry walked in the hard direction) -> route-failed live / route-verified pruned -> escalate gate held with the full packet -> released 'abandon' -> closeout outcome=escalated-abandon with the packet as the record, runner_exit done.

what_the_lap_proves: (1) the when-pair routes on the VERIFIER verdict, exactly one arm per lap, both directions walked; (2) the fresh-seat verifier is not a recap: on the failed lap it independently re-probed and contradicted nothing - on the ok lap it added probes (cat -A, negative grep for the old value) beyond the builder's check; (3) no auto-retry loop exists: the escalate context names the receiver's scheduler as the retry owner, matching v0.1 core (no loop idiom); (4) the land arm answers gate data strictly (land_gate.answer read as data).
hygiene: two seeds (target, attempt_note) literal-baked; zero {run.*} refs in prompts (grep-verified); no vendor ids or estate paths in-file; make_public 0 scrub hits.
